Sneha Bhat
Mobile App Engineer | Thane West
sneha.bhat141@example.com | +91 9157665304

Experienced React Native developer focused on building performant cross-platform mobile apps with a strong emphasis on maintainability and user experience. Comfortable driving feature delivery end-to-end, collaborating with designers and backend teams, and shipping measurable improvements in engagement and reliability.

Experience
Saffron Bank — Jun 2024 - Present
React Native Developer · Remote
- Implemented TypeScript-based feature modules and migrated 35% of legacy screens from JavaScript to TypeScript, reducing runtime type errors by 48% and improving developer onboarding speed.
- Built secure authentication flows integrated with Firebase Auth and Firestore rules, decreasing login-related support tickets by 30% and improving session stability across iOS and Android.
- Optimized React Native rendering and reduced average app cold-start time by 22% through code-splitting and asset optimization, measured across a cohort of 2,000 beta users.
- Collaborated using Confluence to document component contracts and release notes; authored 12 pages of architecture and testing guidelines that sped up feature reviews.

Tata Consultancy Services — Sep 2023 - May 2024
React Native Developer · On-site
- Developed core app features in JavaScript and React Native for a finance client, delivering 10+ screens with reusable components and reducing duplication by 40%.
- Integrated Firebase Cloud Messaging and Firestore to support real-time notifications and state sync; improved notification delivery reliability to 98% in production.
- Implemented Redux patterns for predictable state management across complex flows, which simplified debugging and decreased bug-fix cycle time by 25%.
- Maintained product documentation and sprint artifacts in Confluence, enabling cross-team visibility and reducing handover time between squads.

Covalent Infotech — Nov 2021 - Aug 2023
React Native Developer · Hybrid
- Built and maintained customer-facing React Native apps using Firebase backend services, contributing to a 15% increase in monthly active users through iterative feature launches.
- Implemented offline-first data sync with Firestore and background sync strategies, improving app usability in low-connectivity areas and reducing data conflicts by 60%.
- Collaborated on component libraries and shared UI patterns to enforce consistency; introduced TypeScript typings in selected modules to catch integration issues earlier.
- Used Redux for app-wide state and Confluence for sprint documentation, enabling smoother handoffs and clearer release plans.

Projects
Expense Tracker — Personal project
- Built a cross-platform expense tracking app using React Native, Firebase Auth and Firestore for secure data storage; implemented Redux for state and TypeScript for core modules. Achieved a 4.6/5 user rating in a limited user group.

Skills
Languages: Javascript, TypeScript
Frameworks/Libs: React Native, Redux
Tools/Platforms: Firebase, Confluence

Education
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College
